official_measurement_examples.name: Planning permission separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Water-company guidance explicitly states that planning permission does not grant permission to build over a public sewer or drain.

official_measurement_examples.name: Build-over proximity
official_measurement_examples.fact: Water-company build-over rules commonly use proximity to public sewers and lateral drains; exact thresholds and asset classes must remain undertaker-specific.

official_measurement_examples.name: New property distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: Some undertakers require diversion rather than build-over for new properties; extension rules must not be generalised to all development.

official_measurement_examples.name: Adoption agreement
official_measurement_examples.fact: Ofwat's adoption code concerns transfer of responsibility for qualifying infrastructure constructed by developers or self-lay providers; it is not planning permission.

official_measurement_examples.name: Section 106 sewer connection
official_measurement_examples.fact: Water Industry Act sewer connection rights/processes are distinct from section 106 planning obligations despite the shared section number.

official_measurement_examples.name: Section 185 diversion
official_measurement_examples.fact: Statutory sewer-diversion mechanisms are separate from planning permission and from build-over approval.

official_measurement_examples.name: Asset map limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Sewer maps and searches do not replace site verification, CCTV, exact location or condition evidence where an undertaker requires it.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Sewer approval does not establish title, planning permission, drainage capacity or final development yield.

core_rules: planning permission is not build-over approval
build-over approval is not planning permission
sewer adoption is not planning permission
section106 sewer connection is not planning section106 obligation
section185 diversion is distinct from build-over
undertaker criteria remain company and asset specific
public sewer map is not exact surveyed location
asset proximity is not capacity evidence
connection right/process is not network capacity guarantee
build-over agreement does not establish ownership
sewer adoption does not establish land title
building regulations protocol is not universal undertaker consent
new-property and extension rules remain distinct
CCTV condition evidence may be required
no parcel sewer clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
